site_name: 1 Aubury Place(Land To Rear Of44 - 74 Emlyn Road)LondonW12 9DF
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: Pruning of 7no. trees to the side and rear of No.1 Aubury Place, subject to Tree Preservation Order: TPO/286/6/00, consisting of a Tall Lime tree (T1), where the entire crown is to be reduced to previous reduction points and removal of all deadwood/damaged branches and any low epicormic; 2no. Lime trees, where the entire crowns are to be reduced to previous reduction points and the removal of all deadwood/damaged branches and any low epicormic growth; a Maple tree (Acer) (T4), where the crown is to be reduced by 25% to suitable growth points and shape to balance and tidy; a Prunus tree ssp (T5), where the crown is to be reduced by 25% to suitable growth points to shape into natural rounded canopy line; and 2 no. Lime trees (T6 and T7), where the crowns are to be reduced to previous reduction points (maintaining lower 'screening' growth).
